newsitem.title: USA: Biomagnetic names Buchanan president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Biomagnetic names Buchanan president, CEO.

text.p: Biomagnetic Technologies Inc said on Wednesday its board named Scott Buchanan as president and chief executive officer.

A spokesman was not available to comment on whom Buchanan was replacing. In December 1996, BTI announced a restructuring of its operations due to market uncertainty for its products, and a resultant reduction of staff by a total of 44 persons by the end of its fiscal year ending September 1997.
Buchanan is replacing James Schumacher as president and chief exeutive officer. Buchanan had been serving as interim president and chief operating officer since December.
Schumacher, who stepped down as chairman on Tuesday, will remain as a boardmember and a consultant to the firm.
